title: 第23章 撒豆成兵第24章 螳螂捕蝉黄雀在后
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
不过半日功夫，那几只去探风的穿山甲精便“哧溜”一声钻出地皮，连滚带爬地扑到蛇妖跟前，急吼吼叫道：
“报！大王！打听清楚了！那东山黑瞎子之所以肯卖死力气，是因那斑斓大虫许了天大的好处，说是只要端了咱们南山，这枯骨岭便劈成两半，与那憨熊平分秋色！”
“放他娘的连环臭狗屁！”蛇妖一听，猛地一抽尾巴，三角眼里满是鄙夷与狐疑，
“那蠢虎脑子里装的尽是些烂肉大粪，平日里抠搜得连根骨头都不肯多给手下，能想出这等割肉饲狼的毒计？他若真舍得让出一半基业，太阳都能打西边出来！这背后定有高人指点！”
说罢，蛇妖一把揪住那穿山甲精的脖颈，吐着腥臭的红信子厉声喝问：“快说！那蠢物这几日是不是接触过什么外人？”
几个小妖被吓得面面相觑，一个蛤蟆精挠了挠满头绿包，怯生生道：“大王，小的们真没见他接触过什么外人。
不过……昨日小的在岭上撒尿，远远瞧见那虎大王在南边‘沉湖’一带的枯骨岭上瞎转悠，好像还跟个什么东西搭过话，随后便火急火燎地回了东山！”
“沉湖？”蛇妖三角眼猛地一眯，眼中凶光大盛，咬牙切齿道，“好哇！老子倒要看看，是哪路不长眼的王八羔子，敢在背后给老子捅这等软刀子！今日非活剥了他的皮不可！”
话音未落，这老泥鳅也顾不得身上被火烧焦翻卷的鳞片，一把掣出那两把淬毒的蛇骨双剑，大喝一声：
“小的们，跟老子走！”
但见他身形一晃，“嗖”的一声化作一道绿油油的腥风，卷起几个心腹小妖，杀气腾腾地直奔沉湖方向狂飙而去。
那老泥鳅驾着绿惨惨的妖风，不多时便逼近了沉湖地界。
隔着老远，蛇妖猛地打了个寒颤，三角眼滴溜溜一转，硬生生按住了风头。
他吐着红信子，嗅了嗅空气中那股纯正森然的清气，心里顿时“咯噔”一下：“嘶！好强的鬼仙气息！”
这世间凡是修成正果沾上个“仙”字的，哪怕是垫底的鬼仙，也绝不是好惹的善茬。
蛇妖摸了摸胸前被烧焦翻卷的鳞片，心里隐隐打起了退堂鼓。
可转念一想，自己百年的基业就这么稀里糊涂地被人端了，这口恶气若是咽下去，非得活活憋死不可！
“管他什么仙，断老子财路，就是天王老子也得咬下他一块肉来！”
老泥鳅恶向胆边生，大喝一声，带着几个残兵败将继续往前狂飙。
沉湖边的大青石上，陶潜忽见天边卷来一团腥臭扑鼻的绿云，里头还夹带着几个歪瓜裂枣的蛤蟆精、长虫怪。

老道拐杖拍打着腿，浑浊的眼睛扫了他们一下，笑道：“看来是正主寻仇来了。”
说罢，他不慌不忙地从怀里掏出那面黑气缭绕的“镇魂锣”，操起那根桃木拐杖，照着锣面“咣”的就是一下！
这一声锣响，直如平地起个炸雷，一圈黑色的音波荡漾开去。
那些个刚按落云头的小妖，只觉脑瓜子里“嗡”的一声，三魂七魄都险些被震出窍来，一个个双眼翻白，口吐白沫，“扑通扑通”如下饺子般栽倒在地，四脚朝天地直抽搐。
唯独那吞云大王道行深厚，虽被震得气血翻涌，却硬生生稳住了身形。
他死死盯着陶潜手里那面黑铜锣，原本就绿惨惨的老脸此刻更是阴冷得快滴出水来。
蛇妖咬着后槽牙，两把淬毒的蛇骨双剑在身前一横，阴恻恻地冷笑道：
“好个深藏不露的老鬼！本王当是谁在背后捣鬼，原来是你！那斑斓蠢虎向来是一毛不拔的铁公鸡，今日竟连这压箱底的‘镇魂锣’都舍得送了你！看来，你这老鬼定是给了他们天大的好处，才教那两个蠢货联手端了老子的洞府罢！”
陶潜将那镇魂锣往怀里一揣，拄着桃木拐杖，嘿嘿笑道：
“你这老泥鳅倒也不算太笨。实不相瞒，那斑斓蠢虎本是拿这破锣做定金，求老道我出山，与他联手将你剥皮抽筋。老道我嫌打打杀杀污了清修，不想多事，这才随口指点了他一句‘和众’之策，让他去寻那憨熊罢了。”
蛇妖一听，气得七窍生烟，满嘴毒牙咬得咯咯作响，指着陶潜怒骂道：“好个歹毒的老鬼！你三言两语便毁了老子百年基业，今日非扒了你的皮点天灯不可！”
“莫急，莫急！”陶潜摆了摆手，浑浊的老眼里闪过一丝狡黠，“买卖不成仁义在。你若也舍得拿件趁手的法宝出来孝敬，老道我今日便再发发慈悲，也赐你一计。保准叫你摆脱眼下这丧家之犬的困局，如何？”
“放你娘的连环臭狗屁！老子先活吞了你，再自己搜！”
蛇妖哪里肯听这等敲骨吸髓的鬼话，大吼一声，一脚踢醒两个装死的野猪精，
“还装死！给老子拿下这老妖道！”
说罢，他自己也掣出蛇骨双剑，化作一道腥风，劈头便朝陶潜砍去。
“冥顽不灵！”陶潜冷哼一声，不退反进，不慌不忙地从袖中摸出一斗赤红如血的豆子。
只见他大袖一挥，将那赤豆漫天撒下，口中暴喝：“雷霆霹雳，天威敕令。五方五土，化为神兵。急急如律令！”
那一把赤豆落地迎风便长，“砰砰”连声爆响，平地里刮起一阵阴风。
转眼间，那百十粒赤豆竟化作百十个披坚执锐、青面獠牙的重甲阴兵！这些阴兵浑身鬼气森然，手执长戈大戟，呼啦啦一下便将蛇妖和那几个残兵败将团团围在核心，兵器如林，齐刷刷指向那老泥鳅。

陶潜拿拐杖点了点被逼停在原地的蛇妖，嗤笑道：“你这老泥鳅，方才被那蠢虎和憨熊烧焦了鳞、打断了骨，如今不过是强弩之末。
就凭你现在这半死不活的样儿，也想跟老道我动手？真动起手来，你万万奈何不了老道！还是乖乖破财消灾罢！”

content_en:
In just half a day, the few pangolin spirits that went to explore the wind came out of the ground with a "chirp" sound, rolled and crawled towards the snake demon, and roared urgently:
"Report! Your Majesty! Let me find out clearly! The reason why the black blind man from Dongshan is willing to work hard is because the beautiful insect promised huge benefits. He said that as long as he takes our Nanshan Mountain, the Withered Bone Ridge will be split in half, and he will be evenly matched with that stupid bear!"
"F*cking serial stinky shit!" Upon hearing this, the snake demon twitched its tail, its triangular eyes filled with contempt and suspicion.
"That stupid tiger's mind is full of rotten meat and excrement. He usually digs out even a single bone and refuses to give it to his men. How can he come up with such a vicious plan of cutting meat to feed wolves? If he is really willing to give up half of his foundation, the sun will shine out in the west! There must be an expert behind this!"
After saying that, the snake demon grabbed the pangolin spirit by the neck, spitting out the smelly red letter and shouted: "Speak quickly! Has that idiot come into contact with any outsiders in the past few days?"
Several little demons were so frightened that they looked at each other. A toad spirit scratched his green head and said timidly: "Your Majesty, you guys have never seen him come into contact with any outsiders.
But... yesterday, when I was peeing on the ridge, I saw the tiger king wandering around on the Dry Bone Ridge in the 'Shenhu' area in the south. He seemed to have talked to something, and then he returned to Dongshan in a hurry! "
"Shenhu?" The snake demon's triangular eyes suddenly narrowed, with a fierce glare in his eyes, and he gritted his teeth and said, "Okay! I want to see who is this blind bastard who dares to stab me in the back with such a soft knife! I must skin him alive today!"
Before he finished speaking, the old loach didn't care about the scales on his body that were scorched and rolled by the fire. He pulled out the two poison-quenched snake bone swords and shouted:
"Young ones, follow me!"
But when he saw his body swaying, a "swish" sound turned into a green and fishy wind, which picked up several of his trusted little demons and rushed straight towards Shenhu Lake with murderous intent.
The old loach rode the green evil wind and soon approached the boundary of Shenhu Lake.
A long way away, the snake demon shuddered violently, his triangular eyes rolled around, and he firmly held the spotlight.
He spit out the red letter and sniffed the pure and pure air in the air, and his heart suddenly thumped: "His! What a strong ghostly and fairy aura!"
In this world, anyone who has achieved good results and has the word "immortal" on them, even if they are the ghosts and immortals at the bottom, are by no means easy to mess with.
The snake demon touched the burnt and rolled scales on his chest, and felt faintly retreating.
But then I thought about it, my century-old foundation had been taken away from me in such a stupid way. If I swallowed this bad breath, I would have to suffocate it to death!
"Who cares about the immortal, if he cuts off my wealth, even the king of heaven will have to bite off a piece of his flesh!"
The old loach was so angry that he shouted loudly and continued to rush forward with a few defeated soldiers.
Sitting on the large bluestone beside the lake, Tao Qian suddenly saw a smelly green cloud rolling in from the horizon, with a few toad spirits and insect monsters in it.
The old Taoist slapped his legs with his crutch, glanced at them with his cloudy eyes, and said with a smile: "It seems that the real master has come to seek revenge."
Having said that, he calmly took out the black soul-soothing gong from his arms, picked up the mahogany crutch, and shined the gong with a "bang" sound!
The sound of the gong was like thunder on the ground, and a circle of black sound waves rippled away.
Those little demons who had just pressed down the clouds felt a "buzz" in their heads, and their three souls and seven souls were almost shaken out of their bodies. Their eyes turned white, foaming at the mouth, and they fell to the ground like dumplings with a "plop", and their legs were on the ground and twitching.
Only the Great King Tunyun was profound. Although his energy and blood surged from the shock, he managed to stabilize his body.
He stared intently at the black gong in Tao Qian's hand. His old, green face was so cold that it was dripping with water.
The snake monster bites its back molars, two venom-quenched snake bone swords were stretched out in front of him, and he sneered sinisterly:
"What a secretive old ghost! Who did I think was behind this, and it turned out to be you! That stupid and colorful tiger has always been a hard-nosed rooster, and today he was even willing to give you the 'soul-soothing gong' at the bottom of the box! It seems that you, this old ghost, must have given them a huge benefit, so that you taught those two idiots to join forces to take over my cave!"
Tao Qian put the soul-soothing gong in his arms, leaned on his mahogany crutch, and said with a smile:
"You old loach is not too stupid. To be honest, that beautiful stupid tiger used this broken gong as a deposit to beg me to come out and join hands with him to skin you and cramp you. Old Taoist, I thought that killing and killing had tainted the Qing Xiu, so I didn't want to get into trouble, so I casually gave him a strategy of 'harmony with the crowd' and asked him to go find that stupid bear."
When the snake demon heard this, he was so angry that his mouth was full of fangs. He pointed at Tao Qian and cursed angrily: "What a vicious old ghost! You ruined my century-old foundation with just a few words. I have to skin you and light the sky lantern today!"
"Don't be anxious, don't be anxious!" Tao Qian waved his hand, a hint of slyness flashed in his muddy old eyes, "There is no justice in buying and selling. If you are willing to take out a magic weapon that you have handy and come out to show your respect, I will show mercy to you today and give you a plan. I guarantee that I can help you get rid of the predicament of this lost dog, how about it?"
"Fuck your mother's serial stinking shit! I'll eat you alive first, and then I'll search for you myself!"
The snake demon was not willing to listen to such nonsense. He roared and kicked the two wild boar spirits who were pretending to be dead to wake up.
"You're still pretending to be dead! Get this old demon for me!"
After that, he himself pulled out his double snake bone swords, transformed into a stream of fishy wind, and slashed at Tao Qian's head.
"Stubborn!" Tao Qian snorted coldly, instead of retreating, he took out a bucket of beans as red as blood from his sleeve.
I saw him waving his big sleeves, scattering the red beans all over the sky, and shouting loudly: "Thunder and thunderbolt, the decree of the power of heaven. The five directions and the five earths have turned into divine weapons. Hurry like a law!"
The handful of red beans fell to the ground and grew in the wind. There was a continuous "bang bang" sound, and a gust of cold wind blew in the plains.
In the blink of an eye, those hundred and ten red beans turned into hundreds of heavily armored Yin soldiers with green faces and sharp teeth! These Yin soldiers were full of ghostly aura, holding long spears and halberds in their hands. With a roar, they surrounded the snake demon and the defeated soldiers. Their weapons were like a forest, and they all pointed at the old loach.
Tao Qian used his crutch to tap the snake demon who was forced to stop in place, and sneered: "You old loach, your scales were scorched and your bones were broken by those stupid tigers and stupid bears, but now you are just at the end of your powerful crossbow.
Just because you are half-dead now, do you still want to take action against me? If you really take action, there's nothing you can do to the old man! It’s better to spend money and eliminate disasters obediently! "
